name: Depth Cueing via Linear Attenuation
definition: A shading model that approximates exponential attenuation with locally varying coefficients by linear attenuation with a constant coefficient, allowing the integrand to be expressed as a Fourier projection.
summary: Depth Cueing via Linear Attenuation approximates exponential volume rendering by linearizing absorption, enabling efficient Fourier-based computation of depth-cued X-ray projections.
